rust_summary: disconnect a guest by UUID with a literal reason (`native_kick_player`); while the hub is detached, true means accepted for tick-end resolution, not kicked.
doc_summary: Guest disconnection by UUID with a literal reason. With the hub in place, the owner and unknown players are refused. While detached, true means accepted, not kicked: at most 64 distinct players are queued, the latest reason wins, and tick-end resolution drops requests for the owner or players no longer present. A new player is refused when the queue is full. Requires native hooks API @API:native_kick@.
